entry.summary: Two-merchant double-spend: from the token state rho_P produce two classical cryptograms kappa_0 (Z basis, M0) and kappa_1 (X basis, M1) that both pass.
entry.anchor: Supplementary Information, Supplementary Note 3A 'For N = 1', eqs.(9)-(15), SI PDF p.4-6; main text Methods 'Optimal cheating strategy'

fields.label: Anchor
fields.text: Supplementary Information, Supplementary Note 3A 'For N = 1', eqs.(9)-(15), SI PDF p.4-6; main text Methods 'Optimal cheating strategy'

fields.label: Statement summary
fields.text: Two-merchant double-spend: from the token state rho_P produce two classical cryptograms kappa_0 (Z basis, M0) and kappa_1 (X basis, M1) that both pass. The SDP minimises the error e = Tr(E0 J(Lambda)) the adversary must cause while declaring at most l losses per cryptogram.

fields.label: Sdp primal
fields.text: min Tr(E0 J)  s.t.  Tr_{H0 (x) H1}(J) = 1_{HP};  Tr(E0 J) >= Tr(E1 J);  Tr(L0 J) <= l;  Tr(L1 J) <= l;  J >= 0      (eq. 14)

fields.label: Sdp dual as printed
fields.text: max Tr[X1] + l (x2 + x3)  s.t.  1_9 (x) X1 + L0 x2 + L1 x3 + (E1 - E0) x4 - E0 <= 0,  X1 Hermitian 2x2, x2,x3,x4 real   (eq. 15)

fields.label: Spaces
fields.text: H0, H1: 3-dim {|a0>,|a1>,|empty>}; HP: 7-dim {|v>,|q0>,|q1>,|m0>..|m3>} (vacuum, qubit, 4 orthogonal multiphoton flags)

fields.label: States
fields.text: sigma_k = p0|v><v| + p1 |s_k><s_k| + pm |m_k><m_k| with s_k in {|+>,|+i>,|->,|-i>} (X and Y eigenstates in the SI); rho_P = (1/4) sum_k sigma_k (eq. 9)

fields.label: Operators
fields.text: E0 = (1/4) sum_{k=0}^{3} (1/2)|a_k^perp><a_k^perp| (x) 1 (x) conj(sigma_k);  E1 = (1/4) sum_k 1 (x) (1/2)|a_k^perp><a_k^perp| (x) conj(sigma_k);  L0 = (1/4) sum_k |empty><empty| (x) 1 (x) conj(sigma_k);  L1 = (1/4) sum_k 1 (x) |empty><empty| (x) conj(sigma_k)  (eqs. 12-13; the 1/2 appears in E0/E1 only, as typeset). P0 = Tr sum_k ((1/2)|a_k^perp><a_k^perp| (x) 1) Lambda((1/4) sigma_k) (eq. 10).

fields.label: Observations for lane C
items: The SI dual says 'X1 is a hermitian 2x2 matrix' but HP is 7-dimensional, so the dual variable for Tr_{H0H1} J = 1_HP should be 7x7. Either a typo or a different reduced space. Check before reusing it.

SI eq.(6) defines the Choi operator with a 1/d prefactor, J = (1/d) sum Lambda(|i><j|) (x) |i><j|, and states trace preservation as Tr_{out} J = 1. With the 1/d normalisation that should read (1/d)1, so the normalisation convention is internally inconsistent as printed. MVW (P01) uses no 1/d. Lane C must fix one convention and document it.
The SI writes the qubit states as X/Y eigenstates. The main text writes H/V and D/A. That's a relabeling of an unbiased basis pair, but lanes B/C must use one consistent convention (C7: Z/X).
